source.title: Hippocampal place cells construct reward related sequences through unexplored space.

confidence_rationale: Direct rodent place-cell recordings showing reward/motivational relevance gates which sequences are pre-played -- preplay occurred for the rewarded but not the unrewarded unexplored arm. Strong for MECH-443 (motivational relevance prioritizes replay content) and uniquely relevant to MECH-444 because the constructed sequences cover UNEXPLORED space -- generative recompute beyond stored experience, the biological shadow of reanalyze. Lower confidence than Mattar&Daw because it is preplay (pre-, not post-experience) and the link to a downstream WRITE/update is inferred, not measured.
failure_signatures: This is preplay of never-traversed space; it shows motivational gating of replay CONTENT but does not measure a downstream rule/value update, so the write-gating step is inferred.
Reward here is a binary present/absent contrast, not a graded magnitude, so it supports prioritization-by-relevance but does not establish the shape of the priority function.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Place-cell sequences for an unvisited region of space are pre-activated offline only when that region is made motivationally relevant (food delivered there); a matched unrewarded region produced no such preplay.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-443: motivational/relevance signals gate WHICH transitions are selected for replay, supporting a non-uniform priority over the replay write channel. MECH-444: the sequences are constructed for unexplored space -- replay is generative and goes beyond stored experience, the biological analog of reanalyze recomputing fresh targets rather than re-writing the stale stored ones.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Preplay of unexplored space demonstrates motivational gating of replay CONTENT, not a measured downstream write to a rule/value layer; the update step MECH-443/444 gate is inferred from the content bias, not recorded.
mapping.source_context: Rodent hippocampal place-cell ensemble recordings; rats viewed food delivered to an unvisited arm of an environment.

confidence_components.notes: Direct electrophysiology and a clean rewarded-vs-unrewarded contrast, but preplay-of-unexplored-space is one inferential step from a write-update.
